proba_range.note: Sigmoid calibration compresses extreme probabilities — no ≈0% or ≈100% predictions, consistent with educational domain intuition ('nothing is certain').

threshold_vs_calibration.key_insight: At threshold=0.24, calibrated_positive_rate=54.9% >> actual_rate=33.7%. This is NOT miscalibration (mean proba=0.3429 ≈ actual=0.3374). It's the F1-optimal threshold deliberately favoring recall over precision in an imbalanced setting (base rate=33.7%).

interpretation.calibration: 0 = perfect calibration. Higher = predicted probabilities deviate from observed rates.
interpretation.refinement: Higher = better discrimination across risk groups. 0 = model always predicts base rate.
interpretation.uncertainty: Brier of naive base-rate predictor (=0.3374). Irreducible error ceiling.
